integrity: The proof is self-contained and contains full quantifiers; exact finite rational calculations are supporting checks, not exhaustive verification. Originality is qualified by existing general trajectory-series coverage and the possibility of an unlocated periodic-environment specialization.
scientific_limitations: A fixed initial phase and complementary positive two-periodic step probabilities are essential. The theorem gives the last-discovered site distribution only; no cover-time joint law or arbitrary-period schedule is claimed. A general infinite path series was previously known, and an earlier classical source was inspected by abstract only.
title: A parity-resolved last-coverage law for alternating zero-drift walks on cycles
